verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a cross-platform CLI and set of libraries (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice) that developers run and embed in their own infrastructure. The docs include doxygen API references and code examples, and community users report using the C API and running it in their own pipelines and servers. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement on self-hosted or offline deployment, documentation of an official container or server mode, and clearer library/API tutorials (community reports the libav docs and examples are outdated or thin).

support.subject: As a developer, the conversion engine runs inside my own infrastructure as a library, container, or server I operate

citations.quote: A complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video.
libavformat implements streaming protocols, container formats and basic I/O access.
libavfilter provides means to alter decoded audio and video through a directed graph of connected filters.
Coding examples are available in the doc/examples directory.
